method: Direct read of all 14 .rs files, cross-checked by a corpus-specific lexical inventory (lexical_inventory.py): fn tokens reconciled with declarations, every response_of token classified, every receiver binding reviewed by hand. No ai-architect output was produced or read before this file was written.

schema.functions: Explicit fn definitions: file is repository-relative; line is 1-based declaration line; qualified_name includes manually reviewed impl/module and, for a fn declared inside another fn, the enclosing fn (nested_in); id combines file, line and qualified_name; attributes are contiguous immediately preceding attributes; end_line is the closing brace.
schema.response_of_callsites: Lexical direct method expressions `<receiver>.response_of(` within named functions; method_column is the 1-based column of `response_of` itself; caller_id joins functions.id. Calls inside macros/closures are included in the containing named function. binding_line/binding/receiver_shape record the reviewed local binding of the receiver. inside_macro_on_same_line only denotes a same-line `name!(` prefix and is not a complete macro classifier.
schema.response_of_callers: Distinct containing functions, keyed by source function id; joins functions.id.
schema.counts: Source denominators, not execution or coverage results.
schema.corpus.files.cargo_target: Target from `cargo metadata --no-deps --offline` (raw/cargo-metadata.json); null means no Cargo target has this file as its root.
